newsitem.title: USA: Pep Boys raises $150 mln in note offering.
newsitem.headline: Pep Boys raises $150 mln in note offering.

text.p: Pep Boys -- Manny, Moe & Jack said on Friday it has completed a public offering of liquid yield option zero coupon notes due September 20, 2011, having a yield to maturity of four percent annually.
The notes, which were underwritten by Merrill Lynch, are convertible into common stock of the company at any time, initially at a conversion price of $42.70 per share, Pep Boys said.
Proceeds proceeds from the sale of the LYONs to repay its short-term variable rate bank debt and portions of its long-term variable rate bank debt, Pep Boys said.
